news.title: Lekjaa Says Benslimane Will Host 2030 World Cup Final, Hopes for Morocco-France Clash
news.lede: Casablanca – Fouzi Lekjaa, member of the Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM) Political Bureau and President of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF), said the province will have the honor of hosting the 2030 World Cup final at the Hassan II Stadium. Speaking at an electoral gathering in Benslimane Province, Lekjaa told the crowd, “What you need to know is that Benslimane Province will have the honor of hosting the 2030 World Cup final.” He said the prospect would place development of the province high on the agenda of the government that will take office after the upcoming legislative elections. Whoever serves in the next government will have no option but to develop Benslimane Province,” Lekjaa said.

news.title: Filipinas test young players at Asian Games with World Cup in mind
news.lede: The Philippine women’s football team, also known as Filipinas, during training ahead of the Asian Games 2026. –PFF PHOTO. MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine women’s football team is looking to hit two birds with one stone for its campaign in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Coach Mark Torcaso is looking to steer the Filipinas past the quarterfinal finish they achieved three years ago while also gaining more progression ahead of next year’s Fifa Women’s World Cup campaign. For the Asian Games, Torcaso has put some of the youngsters to the test with a few notable names unavailable.

news.title: Lekjaa announces it before FIFA: Morocco will host the 2030 World Cup final
news.lede: Great Moroccan confidence in settling the race with SpainMorocco have raised the bar in the race to host the 2030 World Cup final. Fouzi Lekjaa, president of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation, has confirmed that the Grand Stade Hassan II in Benslimane will stage the tournament's showpiece, even though FIFA are yet to name the venue for the match.Lekjaa spoke at an Authenticity and Modernity Party event in the city of Bouznika, where he backed Morocco to settle the battle over the tournament's biggest game with striking confidence.As highlighted by the Spanish newspaper " Sport ", the president of the Moroccan federation said: "What you need to know is that the province of Benslimane will have the honour of hosting the 2030 World Cup final." He went further still, picturing the two finalists and wishing for Morocco to meet France.

news.title: The Unity EURO Cup: A celebration of football uniting refugees and their host communities
news.lede: On World Refugee Day we celebrate a competition that has become one of European football’s most inspiring examples of inclusion in action. For people forced to leave their homes, football can provide something invaluable: a sense of belonging. Organised by UEFA and the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), the Unity EURO Cup does just that by bringing together refugees and members of their host communities through football. Since kicking off in 2022, the annual tournament has grown steadily in size and impact.
